UX Design Studio v0.4.0

Include complete workbook, prototyping and product-experience methods inside UX Design Studio.

Download v0.4.0 ZIPOpen the original release

Record notes

Include complete workbook, prototyping and product-experience methods inside UX Design Studio.

The maintained Studio should include complete reusable methods. Earlier public packaging incorrectly routed ordinary work to separate method installations.

Spreadsheet usability now covers inputs, decisions, invalid states, recovery, accessibility and traceability. Product context, screenshot/URL-informed prototyping, experience design, usability testing and appearance work use included methods. Internal compatibility anchors preserve former routes; no separate method pack is required.

Compatibility: Compatible included-method expansion. Existing plugin and skill identifiers remain. Historical local method anchors resolve internally. Actual application, service and runtime requirements are preserved.

Upgrade: Update the existing Studio or Toolkit package. Use its normal skill entrypoints; no additional writing, UX or prompt method pack is needed.

Validation: Changed skill frontmatter and local reference closure checked. Bounded source-grounded procedure cases run without the redundant method packs; UX instruction-coverage checks are separate from real workbook/browser interaction or participant tests. Exact release archive, installation parity and catalog checks are recorded by the release workflow.

Additional integration checks: Adds a persistent saved-source helper with safe replacement and recovery, product pain research, matched-density visual comparison, complete mobile-runtime handoff, stable image-concept identities and richer workbook decision states. Corrects the layout-foundations route. Adds an original palette validator, deterministic export and interactive local preview; native application import is unverified because the host does not expose an allowed settings-control route.

Notes source: github-release:409983707
